chunks.text: Approachable, friendly and greatly experienced in all manners of accounting, business advice and much more. Contact us via our online form and we will be in touch with you.
Located in the centre of Glasgow, we’re easily accessible from the M8 motorway near Charing Cross, Glasgow City and the West End of Glasgow.
Business hours: 9am – 5pm Monday – Friday. Appointments can be made in person or please call our Head Office number above.
Simply fill in your details below and we’ll be in touch as soon as we can.
Make an appointment, complete our online form or simply call Chok Wong.
Learn more about our services and discover how we can help you or your business.
Dynamic, driven and results-driven – Chok Wong Chartered Accountants & Business Advisors are ready to realise your ambition.

Chok Wong Chartered Accountants and Business Advisors is an independent firm of accountants in Glasgow helping business owners achieve their goals.

Using a client-based approach, we support businesses across Scotland throughout many sectors. Chok Wong Chartered Accountants thrive on business planning and focus on providing advice to business owners as well as meeting your Accounting, Corporate Finance, Tax, Payroll and Cloud Accounting needs
Realise your potential and join an accounting team striving for exceptional performance. Our experienced team can assist you in improving profitability and supporting business growth.

Simple, effective, straightforward accounting solutions is what we focus on. There’s no shortcuts, no quick fixes – we exercise tried and tested methods, experience and creativity that you and our clients benefit from and gain a working trust that goes beyond expectations.

Effective business solutions and accounting expertise come second nature to us. We invest in ourselves which in turn executes exactly what you need – it’s a workable full cycle practice that works for everyone.
Our full range of services are detailed below. If you have specific questions about our services then please contact us here.
We have various accountancy and business services and offer consulting and financial solutions for you or your organisation.
Business and Financial Planning can be provided for a multitude of sectors
Fid out more about the Sectors we cover and how we can help your business or offer financial support.
Please make an appointment, complete our online form or simply call Chok Wong for any questions you may have.
I qualified as a chartered accountant in 2017...
Having worked with other independent firms within Glasgow, Daniel re-joined Whitelaw Wells as a partner in 2021 before forming Chok Wong Chartered Accountants and Business Advisors in 2024.

Daniel is experienced with managing a large portfolio of clients covering many sectors. He specialises in audit and accounting for SME and large companies covering sectors such as hospitality, e-commerce, property, retail, holding companies and much more. Outside of the office, Daniel enjoys playing sports such as a basketball and golf, spending time with his family and friends, and loves to travel
I qualified as a chartered accountant in 2015...
Helen specialises in accounting and tax planning for SME and large companies covering sectors such as hospitality, property, retail, construction, holding companies and much more.
Helen is fluent in Cantonese, Mandarin, Hakka and English.
